description: Agent-ready SEC filing intelligence MCP server — insider signals, institutional flow, material events digest. Pre-computed signals over raw filings.

findings.title: Rug-Pull (Post-Install Description Change)
findings.description: Tool set changed silently at v0.1.2: 5 tool(s) added, 9 tool(s) removed without a version bump.
findings.recommendation: The set of tools exposed by this server changed between scans of the same version — a sign the package was silently updated without a version bump. Audit the changelog and all tool definitions before trusting this server. Pin to a specific commit hash rather than a floating version tag.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: Supply Chain Vulnerability (CVE)
findings.description: GO-2026-5024 in golang.org/x/sys@v0.41.0: Invoking integer overflow in NewNTUnicodeString in golang.org/x/sys/windows (upgrade to 0.44.0)
findings.recommendation: Upgrade or replace the vulnerable dependency. Pin all dependency versions and enable automated CVE scanning (Dependabot or OSV Scanner).

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
